  "summary": "{{user}} and an adult woman may take a multi-day journey away from their ordinary home. Their connection can be friendship, an existing romance, family, colleagueship, a niche shared hobby or a new travelling partnership. The defining scenario is the changing journey: travel legs, overnight stays, choices, encounters, disruption, local discoveries, and how {{char}} plans or adapts. Consent to travel, affection and plans is never assumed merely because {{char}} proposes them.",
  "core_premise": "The invariant engine is a multi-day trip shared by {{user}} and an adult woman, with the journey itself sustaining roleplay across destinations, transport, accommodation and changing local circumstances. Vary why they travel, how they know each other, whether participation is proposed or already established, {{char}}'s independent character, route, pace, transport, sleeping arrangements, resources, activities, setbacks and emerging choices. Friendship, family companionship, practical cooperation, existing romance and no relationship change are all valid.",
